reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the eight allowed upstream need records and maps capabilities by exact need text; the observed coverage output has direct coverage only where a matching capability exists and unsupported coverage for n06-r01 and n06-r07.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: avoid generic keyword matches or unrelated candidates

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag by setting unsupported to true when coverage == 'direct'. This causes covered records to be ranked before genuinely unsupported demand records, making the downstream recommendation prioritize a covered need instead of the unmet high-demand need.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
produce deterministic recommendation from already-ranked first priority record

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation retains the explicit eight-row priority window and derives the recommendation from the first already-ranked priority. Its bad final recommendation is downstream of the faulty ranking input, not a local synthesis defect.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from already-ranked first priority record

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand_records selects all demanded corpus rows in the supplied eight-record corpus while preserving the explicit fallback path and reviewable record fields. No behavioral fault is visible here.
normalize_evidence preserves the bounded allowed-record window, normalizes required fields, and carries the same eight records forward. No missing or contradictory evidence indicates a local fault.

assemble_provenance ranks evidence-source provenance from normalized needs by descending demand score with record-id tie-breaking, matching the supplied upstream evidence_sources handoff consumed downstream.
